# National Tax Reports

> > Comprehensive tax guidance for 2025-2026 covering IRS forms, tax credits, deductions, filing strategies, and retirement income taxation.

National Tax Reports provides detailed tax information for individual filers, including guides on IRS forms, tax credits and deductions, filing deadlines, and strategies for minimizing tax liability. The site covers current tax law changes, retirement planning considerations, and energy efficiency incentives.

## Key Topics

- Form 1040
- Tax Credits
- Child Tax Credit
- Earned Income Credit (EIC)
- Tax Deductions
- Standard Deduction
- Tax Brackets
- Filing Status
- Social Security Taxation
- Energy Tax Credits
- Married Filing Jointly
- W-2 and 1099 Forms
- Tax Filing Deadlines
- IRS
- TurboTax

- [When Can You File Taxes in 2026?](https://nationaltaxreports.com/when-can-you-file-taxes): 2026 tax filing dates and deadlines with W-2 and 1099 timeline
- [First Day to File Taxes in 2026: When Can You Start Filing Taxes?](https://nationaltaxreports.com/when-is-first-day-to-file-taxes): 2026 tax season start date and filing timeline information
